title: Figma tool-call limit reached: all Figma work paused

owner_note.text: The Figma MCP says the daily call limit for the Full seat on the Professional plan is used up (five agents shared it). All Figma edits and screenshots stop until it resets, or until you move the seat or plan up (about 2 minutes in Figma billing). Everything done so far is saved in the file. Waiting: Component notes has three temporary clones to delete (327:24441, 327:24740, 327:24896), the Demos page 254:7646 is not deleted yet, and the Apps QA fixes, Cards, Inputs and Layouts helper passes are mid-run.
